modules.name: img_hist_accumulator
limitations: 8-bit scalar grayscale/Y only
Static frame dimensions
Two enabled clocks per accepted pixel; 256-clock clear before each frame
No frame storage or automatic replay
COUNT_WIDTH must be 1..32; frame pixels must fit it
Bad SOF/EOL or bin saturation invalidates the frozen histogram

modules.name: img_hist_ratio_u8
limitations: Unsigned numerator <= denominator and denominator > 0
COUNT_WIDTH must be 1..32
Serial COUNT_WIDTH+8-step division; no throughput or resource measurements

modules.name: img_hist_he_lut_builder
limitations: External histogram read request/response service required
External inactive LUT bank and success-only commit required
External replay of the original frame required
Single gray/Y plane only
Tag/bin/total inconsistencies terminate with error; partial LUT writes must be discarded
Serial divider limits LUT build throughput

modules.name: img_hist_lut_map
limitations: 8-bit scalar lookup only
Both 256-entry banks are uninitialized until explicitly built
A valid commit activates at the next accepted SOF, not on the commit edge
Config success response waits for activation SOF
Missing active LUT produces identity data with m_error=1
No frame buffer or histogram computation inside this mapper

modules.name: img_hist_clahe_clip
limitations: One externally accumulated 256-bin tile at a time
Strict ascending unit redistribution repeats until all excess is assigned
Total count above 256*clip_limit returns explicit capacity error and emits no histogram
Single synchronous RAM port is time-multiplexed; no one-bin-per-clock claim
Use img_hist_clahe_frame for complete tile/frame scheduling

modules.name: img_hist_clahe_interp
limitations: Requires four matching pre-read LUT values and external tile/fraction calculation
Valid FRACTION_BITS is 1..12; F=0, F>12, or out-of-range fractions return m_error=1 and gray=0
Five elastic registered stages; no intermediate rounding; final round-half-up/shift/saturation only
Input accept to m_valid is five enabled edges and II is one enabled edge without stalls; CE or backpressure extends wall-clock latency
Physical signoff is limited to v90 HE16 and v94 CLAHE64x32 finite configured tops; no arbitrary-parameter or sustained-video claim
No neighborhood selection, border policy, tile RAM banking or frame scheduling

modules.name: img_hist_clahe_controller_placeholder
limitations: Legacy interface has no pixel ports; never select it for new processing
Every accepted command retains done_error=1 and done_error_code=0x80
Complete replacement is img_hist_clahe_frame

modules.name: img_hist_frame_engine
limitations: 8-bit scalar grayscale/Y; no RGB chroma storage
Static dimensions 1..512 each; frame pixels must fit COUNT_WIDTH=1..32
One synchronous stored frame with sequential capture/process/replay; no overlap or real-time throughput claim
CLAHE tile dimensions must be even, at least 2, and exactly divide frame dimensions
CLAHE tile count must be 1..256; FRACTION_BITS=1..12
Strict count-preserving ascending redistribution rejects clip limits with insufficient capacity
Tile-center bilinear interpolation and nearest border tile extension; not OpenCV bit parity
Reset cancels incomplete frame; no implicit timeout
Physical signoff is limited to v90 HE16 and v94 CLAHE64x32 finite configured tops; no arbitrary-parameter or sustained-video claim

modules.name: img_hist_he_frame
limitations: Complete internal-frame-buffer HE entry
Normalized CDF_min mapping; constant frames preserve original gray
Shares img_hist_frame_engine dimensions, CE/ready, storage and throughput constraints
No external second pass required

modules.name: img_hist_clahe_frame
limitations: Complete internal-frame-buffer multi-tile CLAHE entry
Absolute per-bin clip count; not normalized floating clip parameter
Strict iterative redistribution, per-tile LUTs and center bilinear interpolation
Shares img_hist_frame_engine static dimensions and full-tile constraints
No external second pass required
